slice: Typed NULL and subquery optimization order: tests and rejected prototype

decision.reason: The broad typed-NULL simplifier fixes the four original multirow-subquery observations but suppresses two previously preserved ANSI CAST failures. Four further regressions occur in the new corpus.
decision.next_implementation: Reproduce Spark early local-relation evaluation, one-row subquery inlining and recursive subquery optimization before enabling general typed-NULL propagation. Correlated dead-subquery removal must also precede DataFusion executable-plan validation.

prototype.change: The existing UDF simplify hook accepts every NULL literal instead of only the decorrelator untyped NULL sentinel. No arithmetic or execution kernel is changed.
